main.description: A reader's reading of a book no catalogue they use holds: the home of last resort, so any book can be added to a library and reviewed. One per book. Status, dates, rating, review and progress live here as they do on a buzz.bookhive.book or a social.popfeed.feed.listItem; the book is named in every key anyone uses, so any app that recognises one of them can show the reading. When the book gains a page in a catalogue app the reader uses, Resenha offers to move the reading there.

stars.description: In half stars, 1 to 10, as BookHive and Popfeed keep them.

review.description: The review as plain text. A formatted version, when there is one, is a site.standard.document the reader's ink.resenha.bookReview links to.

coverUrl.description: The cover as the reader's app found it, for apps without a catalogue to ask. Kept for Resenha before 1.6.10, which reads only this; newer builds also write covers.

covers.description: Every address of the cover the reader's app knew, surest first. A reader tries the next when one fails.

coverImage.description: The cover itself, kept in the reader's repository, for a book whose cover has no lasting address elsewhere.

progress.description: How far through the book the reader is, as BookHive's bookProgress has it.
